messages.subject: Project Falcon - completion conditions
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Margaret,

To satisfy the conditions to completion we need: (1) the landlord's licence to the change of control for Brookfield Mill, and (2) Pawsome Retail Group's written consent to the change of control. Could you chase both? We're targeting completion on 27 February.

Kind regards,
Elena

--
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
This email is confidential and may be legally privileged.
